v: Finally a proper women-led commercial entertainer without all the gyaan 😍 Tabu + Kareena + Kriti simply take over and have fun. Logic can take a small coffee break 😜
e: CREW works for me because it behaves like a straightforward commercial crime-comedy and lets its three leading ladies carry the fun. Logic takes a back seat at times, but the casting, witty writing and performances make that easy to forgive.
body:
it’s been ages since Bollywood came up with a PROPER Women Centric Movie without any Agenda or Propaganda or Forced Feminism….I remember #Kahani was the last one such movie, while Kahani was a Crime Thriller….CREW is a proper commercial entertainer 😍 which boosts of having some wonderful artists Tabu, Kareena & Kriti Sanon

Being a proper commercial movie the content has its own ups and downs wrt logic or cinematic freedom (which general Bollywood critics and so called Directors worry about a lot) but all that goes for a toss with some wonderful performances……Special Kudos to the Casting department for such an apt casting!!!

All three of Tabu, Kareena & Kirti were on fire both looks and performance wise and they carried the movie wonderfully on their shoulders 🙏 The best part I loved in this movie was just how in Hero centric movies there is nothing for a Heroines….similarly this commercial Women centric movie has nothing much for its Hero’s 🤣

The special surprise of this movie is Kapil Sharma who played a subtle role as Tabu’s husband which is completely opposite to what we expect from Kapil Sharma and he did a very good job 👍

If you have watched Rajesh Krishnan’s last comedy thriller #Lootcase this movie Crew is pretty much similar Comedy Crime movie which shows the ups and downs of three air hostess with witty dialogues and performances by the 3 main ladies!!!

v: Tillu Square adds almost NOTHING new... and that is exactly why it works 😂 Same Tillu madness, same fun, with an extra Radhika kick 😍
e: Tillu Square knows its audience already understands Tillu’s world, so it wisely avoids reinventing the formula. Siddhu remains the heart and soul, Anupama brings fresh energy and the returning characters make the sequel feel like another hilarious event in Tillu’s life.
body:
Even before you step into theatre for this sequel, you exactly know what kind of movie you are about to watch and have your expectations set accordingly and thats the greatest plus for Tillu Square!!!!

while the positives of first part #DJTillu is its surprise element with the hero characterisation, Costumes, One liners & Dialogue Delivery….where as in the Second part the main Positive was the audience are prepared for what they are going to watch!!!

Music, Content and Direction wise they didn’t even try to add anything new into the sequel and surprisingly that worked 🙏 Except for adding 3 main characters all the remaining characters were continued from the original thus making the story just another event in Tillu’s life!!!!

while Siddhu is the heart and soul of this film, Anupama added the fresh dose of Glamour to the content…..and the special entry by the OG Radhika aka Neha Shetty gives the extra dose of kick to the film 😍

Tillu Square is one such rare movie where nothing EXTRA is added to its prequel and just gives what the audience want and yet make them laugh and enjoy it more than the first part 🙏

v: Super interesting concept and surprisingly good visuals... but ayyo that SLOOOOOOOOOOOW narration 😞 The lag almost murdered my curiosity before the twist could save it.
e: GAAMI has an intriguing concept, ambitious interwoven screenplay and surprisingly strong camera/VFX work for its budget. The final twist keeps you guessing, but the painfully slow narration drains so much energy that the journey starts feeling eternal long before the climax arrives.
body:
A Unique Concept Narrated in C/o Kancharapalem style of screen play with Top Notch Visuals (based on the limited budget) and Camera Work SPOILED all together by SLOOOOOOOOOOOW PACE Narration 😞 This is a perfect example of how a bad work in particular craft kills the whole movie!!!

To Start with Concept wise the team tested with a unique storyline which grabs audience attention and keeps them guessing about the possible climax with a proper twist which will blew away your imagination. Though the end twist may be hard to digest for orthodox movie lovers and for the audience who love different concept movies will find it interesting though not convincing

Screenplay of the movie is largely inspired from C/o Kancharapalem….but in C/o Kancharapalem the regular boy next door kind of love stories make the audience feel connected, whereas in Gaami the emotional & physical trauma of the characters will make the audience bit uncomfortable and disconnected a bit due to this screenplay!!!

BGM has been apt for this kind of movie and special mention to the Camera Work and the CGI team for their efforts to give some visual treat scenes with the limited budget they had 🙏🙏

Acting wise it would be new to see Vishwak Sen in such a subtle & dull character as we are used to his over energetic performances previously and he had nothing much to do in this movie apart from carrying that sick & confused look throughout……all the other characters did good job as per their character limitations.

Now coming to the main villain of this movie…..its the Painful Lag right from the word go till the climax!!!! You will feel like you have been watching this movie for an eternity 😞 which kills all the enthu of wanting to know how this unique concept movie unfolds. If you remember Rubber Balaji character from Amrutham, you will get a feel that this movie has been definitely directed by him 🤣

v: I expected another routine patriotic movie and got a proper big-screen blast 🔥 Hrithik + Deepika + those aerial fights in 3D... full paisa vasool for me 😍
e: I went in expecting another Bollywood patriotic film built around familiar India-Pakistan beats and came out completely surprised. Hrithik and Deepika own the screen, but the spectacular aerial-action sequences are the real heart of FIGHTER and make this a proper big-screen 3D experience.
body:
Don’t miss this movie on Big Screen with 3 D Glasses on!!!

To be frank when the Trailer dropped I was not so excited to watch this movie as I felt its just another Bollywood movie of cooking a story around Surgical Strikes to encash the sentiment…….but Man I was wrong!!!! This is one of THE BEST INDIAN ACTION WAR FARE movie I watched on screen and it’s a must watch on 3D

To start with…..HRITHIK had just nailed it with his Greek God Looks and amazing screen presence and who better than Siddharth Anand knows how to project him on screen, he previously did the same with Bang Bang and WAR and now again in Fighter!!! Siddharth knows how best he can make use of Hrithik’s charismatic personality 😍 It was an eye feast to watch him in Airforce Uniform 🫡

DEEPIKA was 🔥 in this movie and in few scenes she literally snatches away our eyes from Hrithik…..she did a fantastic job!!!! and it was total 😍 to watch the pair of Hrithik & Deepika on screen and I wonder why it took so long to cast them together 🙏

Content wise it is a Tailor made Commercial Patriotic movie with Surgical Strike as backdrop filled with good emotional points and bit over the top patriotism and obviously villian being Pakistan 😉

apart from Hrithik and Deepika’s excellent screen presence…..The Action parts are the Heart and Soul of this movie and I have never seen such AIR stunts in an Indian Movie which literally gives Goosebumps and provide WOW factor to this movie!!! Especially watch them

in 3D for a wonderful experience 🔥😍🫡

a MUST WATCH movie for all the Action movie lovers and especially Kids…..and if you are Hrithik (or) Deepika fan then its a Double Dhamaka for you guyz!!!!!
